blocks.html: Appropriate safeties shall be provided so that detection of heat within the generator or equipment room shall prevent additional fuel oil from being pumped into the piping system within such room, including a fusible link operated lever gate valves in the supply pipe at the suction side of the fuel oil transfer pump and in the supply pipe entering the generator, fuel oil burning equipment room or rooftop equipment enclosure.
